usage: spec sfx: { "src": "@sfx:whoosh", "at": 2.5, "anchor": true } (role, or the first available item of a category), or "@sfx:swish-3" (one item). anchor: true puts the audible impact (anchor_s) on `at`. Items outside the kit come with `library pull --sfx`.
